label: Micius to Zvenigorod (Khmelev 2023), measured clear-sky atmosphere
source: Khmelev et al., arXiv:2310.17476 (2023), the Micius pass over Zvenigorod of 1 March 2022
note: A second Micius link with its own measured pass: a 600 mm station, an atmosphere fitted to the counts (0.88 dB at the zenith) and no pointing term, as the paper's model has none. Checked in tests/test_satellite_network_is_checked.py against its sifted rates at 600 and 1,100 km.

orbit_altitude_km.quote: Micius orbiting at an altitude of ~500 km (Liao et al. 2017; the paper uses TLE data for the same satellite)

station_altitude_km.quote: placed at the Zvenigorod observatory (Moscow region, 55 deg 42' N, 36 deg 45' E, altitude of 198 m)

beam_divergence_urad.quote: Table I: gamma (Rad) 10^-5, in eta = eps D_T^2 / (gamma d)^2 ... the same law this model uses

rx_aperture_m.assumption: Table III: a 600 mm telescope with obstruction (eps) 0.73, which multiplies D_T^2 in their Eq. (2); folded in here as an equivalent clear aperture of 0.6 x sqrt(0.73) m

receiver_optics_efficiency.assumption: Table II fits 21, 35, 37 and 19 percent for the four polarisation channels and the model averages the four; their mean is used

atmospheric_db.quote: the atmospheric extinction coefficient kappa = 0.22 +/- 0.04, which corresponds to clear weather conditions
atmospheric_db.note: kappa is in magnitudes per air mass (their Eq. 2, 10^(-0.4 kappa csc(theta))), so 0.4 x 0.22 x 10 = 0.88 dB at the zenith.

atmospheric_ref_km.assumption: kappa is a zenith figure: 499.8 km is the zenith range for a 500 km orbit over a 198 m station, which this model maps to 90 degrees

pointing_db.quote: it might be explained by additional losses induced by pointing errors between the Micius satellite and the Zvenigorod ground station
pointing_db.note: Their model carries no pointing term and names pointing as the likely missing loss; none is added here, so this profile reads high where pointing matters.

dark_count_prob.assumption: Appendix B: night-sky and dark counts of 290 +/- 60 clicks per second over the four detectors, which the 2 ns filter reduces about five times (their Y0 = N / (5 f)); 2 p_dark = 290 / (5 x 1e8). The sunlight the satellite reflects (their T eta(t)) has no term in this model

misalignment.quote: the QBER for a source of signal states are 0.93%, 0.95%, 0.87%, and 0.89%
misalignment.note: Their mean, used as the error floor as Liao's 1.1% is.

detector_dead_time_s.assumption: Not stated; at these count rates a dead time under a microsecond costs under 1 percent

vacuum_decoy.quote: vacuum lambda=0 coherent states and p_alpha in {p_s, p_d, p_v}

min_elevation_deg.quote: The operating elevation angles of the Zvenigorod ground station ranges from 20 deg to 90 deg above the horizon

distance_km.assumption: The page's default slant range, inside the pass's 600 to 1,100 km
